phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless communication radio module designed for real-time soil moisture monitoring in agricultural applications.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification reflects the most common configuration in modern smart agriculture, where capacitive sensing offers durability and accuracy for soil moisture detection, combined with an MCU for data processing and a radio for wireless telemetry. This integrated approach is widely adopted due to its low power consumption and ease of deployment in field sensors.
